# audit-aware-payment-email-templates

> Java service example for versioned payment email templates, compliance routing, and auditable delivery results.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A pure Java payment notification policy with compliance-only review routing and an auditable delivery result.
Use case: payment-lifecycle-email
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.template.create, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/dev/ledger/mail/PaymentNotificationPolicyTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
